Role, source, request, job, witness and retained parent identity are clamped to original capture; slice process evidence is not invented.
Destination challenge and peer, clock function and retention deadline cannot be mixed between roles.
Host cannot refresh the first absolute delivery deadline; logical delivery window is at most 20s including cleanup reserves.
Origin and Store clock observations join the Hub watermark; claim, close and ACK regressions reject backward time without changing trusted clock functions.
Cancellation during opaque claim recognizes the exact ticket owner and retires its reference.
Cancellation during send or ACK never records a successful parent handoff.
New late ACK descriptors are registered and retired; uncertainty invalidates cached successful close without retry after FD-number reuse.
Both original objects can be delivered after unlink; transferred receiver leases and borrowed sockets remain caller-owned.
Wrong or lost ACK and duplicate sends are terminal; dictionaries and foreign module Origins cannot authorize delivery.
